review_notes.evidence: Native block grid IDs, aligned borders and fields fit standard bank columns50,73,96,119,142,165,188 and rows2+7n; local scan skew and glyph bearings do not change the printed lattice. All box bottoms are open. Uppercase and P.N./value gaps follow explicit user policy. No bank shift applied.

Each native printed pin and wedge inspected separately. Blank printed_pin denotes an unlabeled physical port, not inferred lettering. Printed passive connections, where present, use null driver and distinct literal terminal endpoints; prefixes are numeric printed qualifiers.

review_notes.location: Independent LS401 native source and preview review
review_notes.evidence: All39 native blocks and every printed field/port/wedge inspected in native page-specific crops. All16 register input origins, inverted outputs and starred feedthrough outputs traced independently, including AF to BF3G and top DEC16/20. Native long corridors and crossings compared in full upper/lower previews. Four-column connectors and title examined separately. Output continuation groups contain printed diamonds on first reference stem at main row and next two rows, lower elbow at third; other reference hooks are retained. GT09 uses LS001/041/075 and 011/051,021/061,031/071; other gate groups use003/043/077 and013/053,023/063,033/073. Write circuitry FC/BK/FB has plain port borders, unlike3311 AR wedges. BK.D12 toEJ, FC.D07 toFA, FB.D05 toDJ, FB.B05 feedback toFC, FC.D09 terminationFD and BK.D13 feedFB all traced. Title retains literal08─23 while register labels run09─24. Part2585426 FE, single EC713380, full readable bottom footer. Standard245x103 lattice and adjacent pin lettering retained.

Minor subcell ink dropouts are present. Clearly identifiable aligned wire glyphs are retained according to AP policy, without claiming source electrical continuity from a rendered line. No ambiguous full blank cell or net association was established.

review_notes.note: Root independently compared native left/middle/right upper and lower strips, origins labels, far-grid and write-grid, footer and complete connector table; supplemented with own top-rail/DE-EE/EE/connector crops; all3 complete previews compared. All39 card/unit/socket/grid fields and physical pins/stars/wedges,16 decode origins/inverted outputs/feedthroughs and16 gate continuation groups, seven write-circuit cards and all routes/junctions/crossings agree. Native3311 D4G4/D4H4, write3388D4M4/0518B1D4L2, AF-to-BF3G and DE6K-to-EE7K retained. GT09 exceptional continuation list001/041/075 vs others003/043/077; first stems with native diamonds and detached reference hooks preserved. FC/BK/FB plain physical ports, feedbackFB.B05-to-FC.D09, terminationFD.D02, write1DJ/write2FA/write3EJ traced. Source title literal GT LS REGS08-23 vs decode09-24 labels retained; all32 connector lines/part2585426FE081469153A/singleEC713380 agree. Minor partial-cell identifiable print losses keep wire glyphs per AP, actual source electrical continuity unverified.
